newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ'S ASSOCIATE HEALTH MINISTER KIRTON SACKED.
newsitem.headline: NZ'S ASSOCIATE HEALTH MINISTER KIRTON SACKED.

text.p: New Zealand Associate Health Minister Neil Kirton was sacked on Thursday by deputy Prime Minister Winston Peters for breaching an agreement not to speak to media, the New Zealand Press Association reported.
NZPA said Peters made the announcement at a news conference.

Following the realease of an Audit Office report examining the awarding of a health publicity contract to the firm of Kirton's brother-in-law, Peters last night he had "made it very clear to Kirton that there was to be no media comment,

"Last night I made it very clear to Mr Kirton that there was to be no media comment pending a meeting between the Prime Minister and myself to sort out the public dispute between the two health ministers," Peters said in a statement.
Health Minister Bill English and Kirton have publicly been at odds for several months over management of the health portfolio.
